description: This file defines an abstract class 'RelationalStorageTests' used for testing relational storage back-ends in an Orleans-based project. It includes methods for various storage operations, exception handling, and serializer configuration, with dependencies on Orleans and testing utilities.

classes.name: RelationalStorageTests
classes.description: An abstract class providing common testing functionalities for relational storage back-ends in Orleans, including methods for read/write operations, exception testing, and serializer configuration.

methods.name: Relational_WriteReadWriteRead100StatesInParallel
methods.description: Runs a test to perform parallel write/read operations on 100 states.

methods.name: Relational_HashCollisionTests
methods.description: Performs hash collision tests by setting a constant hasher and executing parallel storage operations.

methods.name: Relational_WriteDuplicateFailsWithInconsistentStateException
methods.description: Tests that writing a duplicate record fails with an inconsistent state exception.

methods.name: Relational_WriteInconsistentFailsWithIncosistentStateException
methods.description: Tests that an inconsistent state exception is thrown during a write operation.

methods.name: Relational_Json_WriteRead
methods.description: Performs a write/read test using JSON serialization for a given grain type and state.

methods.name: Relational_Binary_WriteRead
methods.description: Performs a write/read test using binary serialization for a given grain type and state.

methods.name: GetJsonGrainStorageSerializer
methods.description: Creates and returns a JSON serializer for grain storage.

methods.name: GetOrleansGrainStorageSerializer
methods.description: Creates and returns an Orleans serializer for grain storage.
